meta.prompt_suffix: Style: a richly rendered, volumetric semi-3D digital illustration in the visual language of Korean finance-explainer YouTube thumbnails — dimensional forms with real weight, believable materials (brushed metal, glass, brick, paper, fabric, gold), soft ambient occlusion and glossy highlights; every surface has thickness, weight and a light side and a shadow side. A golden sunset or a strong warm key light burns behind the scene and floods it with orange and gold, while the opposite side falls into deep near-black shadow, so the tonal range runs from almost pure black to bright highlight inside one frame. Colours are vivid and poster-like: gold and orange for the winning side, saturated red for loss and danger, saturated green for gain. The frame is CROWDED — signboards, floating panels, round badges, bar charts, thick arrows, stacks of gold coins, cash bundles, brand-free household and office props stacked into every part of the upper picture the way a busy movie poster is, and yet the main figure and the main number still read instantly at thumbnail size. CHARACTER SHEET, identical in every image: a large smooth round off-white head with no hair and no nose, rendered with soft three-dimensional shading and a clean dark outline, always the brightest face in the picture; two big white eyes with round black pupils and visible eyelids; thick solid black eyebrows that change angle with the emotion; a drawn mouth that opens and bends with the emotion; a small simple body in situation clothing with simple rounded hands. If the scene contains more than one person, every one of them is the SAME character with the same head, differing only in clothing, pose and expression. NUMBER RULE: every Korean amount quoted in this prompt is drawn on ONE unbroken line, never split in the middle of a digit group; each character of the largest quoted amount is at least one twelfth of the frame height, while the smaller exact-won line under it stays small. LETTERING RULE: render only the Korean and English words quoted in this prompt; every other board, badge, panel, sign and sheet in the frame is blank — do not invent english text, latin letters, chinese characters, gibberish text, random lettering or invented words anywhere in the image. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark, no graphic divider line.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 메시지: 「같은 40대인데 가운데와 꼭대기가 자릿수로 갈린다」. 40대 순자산 중앙값 2억 8,384만 원 vs 40대 상위 1% 32억 원(verified-data 1·2절)을 좌우 팻말로 세운다. [A 얼굴] 마스코트 — 무연령·무성이라 40대 시청자가 그대로 대입된다 [B 금액] 큰 글자 "2억 8천만" / "32억 원", 잔글씨에 원단위 병기 [C 사건] 낮은 칸에서 손이 미끄러지는 중 [D 주어] 왼쪽에서 미끄러지는 게 내 돈이다 [구도] 좌우대비 [텍스트] 제목「내 자리는 어디쯤」 vs 썸네일「우리 나이대는 몇 층에서 멈춥니까」
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is the deep near-black base of the cracked stone ground and the unlit lower steps, one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No head, no hand, no signboard and no number sits in that bottom three-eighths — every head, hand, panel and number sits in the upper five-eighths, and the upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast, flooded with golden sunset light. SCALE: each mascot's round head spans roughly 30 to 40 percent of the frame height, and the props carrying words are drawn far larger than real proportion so their letters read at thumbnail size. SCENE: a wide split landscape of stone steps. On the LEFT, cold and dim in blue-grey shadow, two low worn steps end against a sheer face too tall to climb; on the RIGHT, blazing gold, a broad staircase whose treads climb far above head height toward a burning horizon. A real physical crack in the ground runs between the two sides. On the left step face a painted label reads "40대" in Korean Hangul, and a leaning wooden signboard beside it carries a huge top line reading "2억 8천만" in Korean Hangul with a small line under it reading "40대 순자산 중앙값 2억 8,384만 원". On the right a tall golden signboard carries a huge top line reading "32억 원" with a small line under it reading "40대 상위 1% 32억 원". A battered cardboard box, a cracked coin jar and a bent shovel crowd the left; stacks of gold coins, cash bundles, a treasure sack and a rising bar chart crowd the right; every corner of the upper frame has something to look at, and every other board and badge in the picture is blank. CHARACTERS: on the left the mascot in a worn grey jacket is caught mid-climb, one rounded hand slipping off the step edge and the other clawing at the stone, thick black eyebrows slanted steeply downward at their inner ends, mouth open in a downward grimace, a big sweat drop flying off the side of the head. On the right the SAME mascot in a neat dark suit stands easily on the high golden step, eyebrows flat and calm, mouth a small closed curve, one rounded hand resting in a pocket.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 메시지: 「위로 갈수록 한 칸이 사람 키만큼 커진다」. 순자산 10억 원 이상이 11.8%뿐이라는 구간 분포(verified-data 2절)를 4층 턱에 매달린 장면으로 물리화한다. [A 얼굴] 마스코트 [B 금액] 큰 글자 "10억 원", 잔글씨 "순자산 10억 원 이상 11.8%" [C 사건] 손끝으로 4층 모서리에 매달려 발이 허공에 뜬 중 [D 주어] 못 올라가고 있는 게 나다 [구도] 은유장면(게이트 C 전담) [텍스트] 제목「4층부터는 다른 세상」 vs 썸네일「나이 칸마다 다른 층 높이」

The lower tiers are crowded and cool blue-grey; the upper tiers blaze gold and are completely empty. Painted on the tier the mascot is hanging from, a big label reads "4층" in Korean Hangul, and mounted on the wall of that tier a huge round golden badge carries a big line reading "10억 원" with a small line under it reading "순자산 10억 원 이상 11.8%". Every other badge, board and sheet in the picture is blank. CHARACTER: the mascot in a rolled-sleeve shirt hangs by both rounded hands from the lip of the fourth tier with its feet kicking in empty air, thick black eyebrows slanted steeply downward at their inner ends, mouth wide open, two big sweat drops flying off the side of the head, one hand already sliding on the stone edge.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 메시지: 「같은 상위 1%인데 나이가 다르면 값이 세 배 넘게 다르다」. 39세 이하 13억 1,000만 원 vs 60대 이상 44억 9,000만 원(verified-data 2절) — 이 편의 핵심 대비를 막대 두 개로 세운다. §5-C 한글+영문 2단 간판 적용 장(2/3). thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 메시지: 「1층과 8층은 같은 건물이 아니다」. 확정 제목의 「8층」을 좌우 극단으로 이행한다 — 1층 1억 원 미만 29.5% vs 8층 47억 4,000만 원(상위 0.5%), verified-data 2절. §5-C 한글+영문 2단 간판 적용 장(3/3). [A 얼굴] 마스코트 둘(같은 얼굴) [B 금액] 큰 글자 "1억 원" / "47억 원", 잔글씨에 원단위·비율 병기 [C 사건] 왼쪽 마스코트가 1층 문턱에서 발을 들었다가 멈춘 중 [D 주어] 열 집 중 세 집이 서 있는 1층이 내 자리다 [구도] 좌우대비 [텍스트] 제목「대한민국 순자산 8층」 vs 썸네일「연령별 순자산 8층 표 / 내 자리는?」

SCENE: one enormous eight-storey stone stair-tower stands across the frame, its lower storeys cold blue-grey and its top storey blazing gold against the sunset, a physical vertical seam of shadow splitting the picture in two. On the LEFT, at the very bottom storey, a painted label reads "1층" in Korean Hangul and a leaning wooden board beside it carries a big top line reading "1억 원" with a small line under it reading "순자산 1억 원 미만 29.5%", and a smaller English second line reading "Floor 1". On the RIGHT, at the top storey, a golden board carries a big top line reading "8층" in Korean Hangul, a second big line reading "47억 원", and a small line under them reading "상위 0.5% 47억 4,000만 원". CHARACTERS: on the left the mascot in a worn zip-up jacket has lifted one rounded foot toward the first step and stopped there, thick black eyebrows slanted steeply downward at their inner ends, mouth bent down, a sweat drop at the side of the head, the other hand gripping the board's edge. On the right the SAME mascot in a tailored dark suit stands at the golden top storey with flat calm eyebrows, a small closed smile and both hands behind its back, tiny at that height.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 메시지: 「몇 층 버튼까지 눌러지는지가 곧 내 자산이다」. 확정 제목의 질문(당신 자리는 몇 층입니까)을 층 버튼으로 물리화하고, 상위 10% 커트라인 11억 원(verified-data 2절)을 층 표시 옆에 세운다. [A 얼굴] 마스코트 [B 금액] 큰 글자 "11억 원", 잔글씨 "상위 10% 11억 원" [C 사건] 버튼이 지금 막 켜지는 중, 손가락이 눌린 채 [D 주어] 내가 누를 수 있는 층이 어디까지인지 [구도] 현장+정보패널 [텍스트] 제목「당신 자리는 몇 층입니까」 vs 썸네일「나이 칸마다 다른 층 높이 / 어느 층?」
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. No head, no hand, no button and no number sits in that bottom three-eighths — every head, hand, panel and number sits in the upper five-eighths, and the upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast, flooded with golden light. SCALE: the mascot's round head spans roughly 30 to 40 percent of the frame height, and the button panel and the indicator are drawn far larger than real proportion so their letters read at thumbnail size. SCENE: a huge brass elevator call panel fills the LEFT half of the frame at mid height, mounted on a warm stone wall. Eight round buttons run up it in a single column; the fifth one is lighting up amber at this exact moment, its glow spilling onto the mascot's rounded hand. Above the panel a large illuminated floor indicator reads "5층" in Korean Hangul, and beside it a broad plate carries a big line reading "11억 원" with a small line under it reading "상위 10% 11억 원". The three buttons above the fifth are dark and unlit while the golden sunset burns through a tall window on the right, throwing long warm bars of light across the wall. The frame is crowded like a poster — a stack of gold coins on a ledge, a cash bundle, a potted plant, blank floating panels, brushed metal doors reflecting the warm light. Every other plate, badge and sign in the picture is blank. CHARACTER: the mascot in a plain office shirt stands on the RIGHT with one rounded finger still pressed on the lit fifth button, head turned up toward the three dark buttons above it, thick black eyebrows arched high, mouth open in a round O, the other hand clutching a rolled blank paper against its chest.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 메시지: 「올라갈 사다리가 위쪽에서 끊겨 있다」. 상위 5% 커트라인 16억 3,000만 원(verified-data 2절)을 6층 벽에 세우고, 그 위로 가는 가로대가 사라진 사다리로 「층 간격이 자릿수로 벌어진다」는 본문을 은유한다. [A 얼굴] 마스코트 [B 금액] 큰 글자 "16억", 잔글씨 "상위 5% 16억 3,000만 원" [C 사건] 손을 뻗다가 없는 가로대를 잡는 순간 [D 주어] 사다리를 오르던 게 나다 [구도] 은유장면 [텍스트] 제목「8층, 당신 자리는 몇 층입니까」 vs 썸네일「마흔 넘어도 여기서 안 올라갑니다」

No head, no hand, no badge and no number sits in that bottom three-eighths — every head, hand, panel and number sits in the upper five-eighths, and the upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast, flooded with golden light. SCALE: the mascot's round head spans roughly 30 to 40 percent of the frame height, and the wall plate is drawn far larger than real proportion so its letters read at thumbnail size. SCENE: a tall stone wall built of eight banded storeys rises across the frame, seen from slightly below. A heavy wooden ladder leans against it, but above the sixth band the rungs are simply GONE — only two broken stubs and empty sockets remain, and beyond them the wall runs up smooth and unclimbable into the burning gold of the sunset. Painted on the sixth band a big label reads "6층" in Korean Hangul, and bolted beside it a broad metal plate carries a big line reading "16억" with a small line under it reading "상위 5% 16억 3,000만 원". Below the mascot the lower bands are cool blue-grey and crowded with props — a toolbox, a cracked coin jar, cash bundles, blank leaflets caught against the wall foot; above the break, gold coins and a golden doorway glow far out of reach. Every other plate, badge and sheet in the picture is blank. CHARACTER: the mascot in a work jacket stands on the highest remaining rung and has just stretched one rounded hand up to where the next rung should be, fingers closing on empty air, thick black eyebrows arched high and pulled together, mouth open wide, one big sweat drop flying off the side of the head, its other hand locked white-knuckle tight on the ladder rail.
